keyEvents.text: Goal! Nottingham Forest 1, Manchester City 0. Jair Cunha (Nottingham Forest) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.

Goal! Nottingham Forest 2, Manchester City 0. Liam Delap (Nottingham Forest) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Xaver Schlager following a fast break.
Substitution, Manchester City. Nico O'Reilly replaces Josko Gvardiol.
Substitution, Manchester City. Matheus Nunes replaces Marc Guéhi.
Second Half begins Nottingham Forest 2, Manchester City 0.
Goal! Nottingham Forest 2, Manchester City 1. Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
